text_block_list.text:
Phew~...!
That race was so much fun~...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Getting cheered on by the fans, and giving it my all against everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was already happy with just that,
and then my name made it onto the board, too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If I had gotten 1st place,
I bet I'd be waaaay happier right now~~!!
choice_data_list: It's okay to just be happy right now!

Then I'm gonna do even mooorre!!

text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
Next time, I'm definitely taking 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because in such an incredible race,
if only I'd come in 1st—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because you would've been way, waaaay
happier, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll train a whole bunch
and become an even more full-power me than before!

text_block_list.text:
"And so... next time, I'm taking first place!
Yeahhh!!"
